title: Pressing!
description: A datapack that makes most items fully renewable in a vanilla friendly way
body:
# Pressing!

Pressing is a small datapack that lets you **automate** most **non-renewable** and some renewable items in Minecraft! It tries to stay true to the vanilla game adding no new blocks or items, only mechanics.

It adds 4 new mechanics:
- Pressing
- Flaming
- Dripping
- Planting

## Pressing

Pressing lets pistons do crafting, press an item using a piston with a block from above and it will change the item!

![An image showing an example pressing setup. It has a sticky piston facing downwards with a iron block.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a484ebddb95950d99a21fcfe7ea9c89de8a53c4a.png)

**See the gallery for recipes!**

## Flaming

Flaming lets campfires do crafting, simply drop items into a campfire for different results.

Examples:

- Cobblestone -> Deepslate
- Sand -> Red Sand

## Dripping

Dripping lets dripstone do crafting, place items under a dripstone spike with water above it and they'll transform into something new!

Examples:

- Sand -> Dirt
- Copper -> Oxidized copper
- Hay Block -> Slimeball

![An example dripping setup. It has a dripstone spike, above it a dripstone block and above that a water source](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/891a36a555937ba701257354780b30ba40d9a4a9.png)

## Planting

Planting lets dispensers plant crops and saplings from below!

![A planting setup. A dispenser with a dirt block above it placing a sapling](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bcb09346516471b99b25292ee02b26d9efb77777.png)

## Q&A

### Q: There are some items here that are already renewable, why is that?

A: Some items like redstone and shulker shells, while renewable, are very difficult to automate in the base game. Most players aren't going to want to transport a shulker to the overworld just for a shulker farm, therefore I've added recipes so they are actually reasonable to automate. Additionally, some items in vanilla require a player to be placing or breaking blocks. I've tried my best to remove semi automatic farms from the game, which is why resin clumps can be automated from eggs and dispensers can plant.

### Q: Recipes?

A: Look at the gallery.
